artworks.title: Argus Building the Ship Argo
artworks.description: Victorian plate — Argus at the keel Athena planned, the muster beginning as wood becomes the speaking ship.

artworks.title: The Building of the Ship Argo
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum canvas — the Argo rising on the strand while Argonauts point toward the open sea from Pagasae.

artworks.title: Building the Argo
artworks.description: British Museum terracotta — Athena oversees the Argo's yard, the vessel the flower of Greece will take to Colchis.

artworks.title: The Argonauts
artworks.description: Costa's Ferrarese crew aboard — the mustered heroes packed into the ship that leaves Iolcus for the fleece.

films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's voyage begins with the muster — heroes boarding the Argo at Pagasae before skeletons and the fleece.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius' catalogue of heroes — Heracles, Orpheus, the Dioscuri, and the flower of Greece taking the oar for Colchis.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: Pelias' one-sandaled nephew — the man who musters the Argo and leads the fleece quest that founds so many later tales.
